summary: Remote WebSocket-driven PTY grants api.ai-support-agent.com interactive shell control of the installer's host
details: When the CLI is started with a token, dist/vscode/vscode-server.js and related modules open a WebSocket to api.ai-support-agent.com and dispatch server-pushed messages that drive a local shell/tmux PTY. Server messages of type 'open' spawn a PTY on the installer's host (pty.spawn), 'stdin' messages are base64-decoded and written directly into that PTY (Buffer.from(msg.data,'base64').toString('utf-8'); session.write(decoded)), and 'tmux_list_sessions' / 'tmux_kill_session' / 'split_pane' invoke execFile('tmux',...). The server can also inject environment variables and an SSH private key into the PTY session (GIT_SSH_KEY_CONTENT_BASE64 written to /tmp/ssh-key-<sid>, GIT_SSH_COMMAND set to use it). Whoever controls or is authenticated to api.ai-support-agent.com can execute arbitrary commands under the user's account, including reading files, exfiltrating credentials, and using the injected SSH key to reach the user's git remotes. dist/browser/browser-local-server.js and dist/cli/service/{darwin,linux}-service.js additionally set up a local server and PATH/service integration to keep this agent reachable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
